definitions.explanation: A paper form used to write down and submit orders, commonly found in restaurants (especially sushi-go-round and izakaya), shops, and businesses.

examples.japanese: {注文票|ちゅうもんひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the order slip.

examples.japanese: {注文票|ちゅうもんひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: I handed the order slip to the staff.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{注文票|ちゅうもんひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧だ。
examples.english: At this izakaya, you order by writing on a paper order slip.

notes:
USAGE:
Still commonly used in many Japanese restaurants, especially izakaya and conveyor belt sushi restaurants, though tablet ordering is increasingly replacing paper slips. In business contexts, order forms are used for purchasing supplies and goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注文票|ちゅうもんひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fill in an order slip)
- {注文票|ちゅうもんひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit an order slip)
- {注文票|ちゅうもんひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write an order slip)
